title.orig: An Act Declaring July Eight of Every Year A Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of Guinsiliban, Province of Camiguin, To Be Known As "Guinsiliban Charter Day"
title.th: วันก่อตั้งตามกฎบัตร Guinsiliban

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8254_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: July eight is the charter day anniversary of the Municipality of Guinsiliban, Province of Camiguin, and its celebration is highlighted with colorful parade, participated in by all barangays, stage drama, sports festival, and beauty pageant.
July eight of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the Municipality of Guinsiliban.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, February 11, 1997.
